title: Restrict owner 679 to seven paid packets in both orientations
body:
## Mathematical result

For any successful fully recoded word on the sole funded 0→19 topology, seven tight-cut witnesses restrict the first 679 delivery to five physical paths in each orientation. Only seven packets can jointly carry the corresponding forward and adjoint coefficient. A local GF(2) conservation identity gives eight allowable joint masks.

## Sources

Canonical main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. #7830 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15 and #8006 4035f150285513852cab8d00b8bfc233c699ea0a. Round 10’s relevant scoped priors are #8008, #8009 and #8011.

## Validation

The standalone cold archive replays all seven exact ranks, both route restrictions, conservation and eight literal diagnostic masks. Those controls preserve 679 and 411 and retain other output errors.

## Open next questions

Use these routing conditions to constrain the remaining full-stock search without substituting a local return for the required whole map.
